mapper.select: select status, candidate_revision as candidateRevision from p_avatar_version where id = #{versionId} and account_id = #{accountId} for update

select cast(v.avatar_id as char) avatarId, v.status versionStatus, v.candidate_revision candidateRevision, cast(v.source_file_id as char) sourceFileId, v.pipeline_version pipelineVersion, cast(t.official_service_id as char) officialServiceId, cast(t.service_snapshot as char) serviceSnapshot, src.status sourceStatus, s.status latestStage, cast(coalesce(a.id, s.reserved_attempt_id) as char) latestAttemptId, coalesce(sel.revision, 0) actionRevision from p_avatar_version v join p_generation_task t on t.id = (select max(t2.id) from p_generation_task t2 where t2.account_id = v.account_id and t2.avatar_version_id = coalesce( cast(json_unquote(json_extract(v.generation_recipe, '$.inheritedFromVersionId')) as unsigned), v.id)) join p_official_service svc on svc.id = t.official_service_id and svc.status = 'ACTIVE' and svc.capability = 'AVATAR_GENERATION' join p_secret sec on sec.id = svc.secret_id and sec.status = 'ACTIVE' left join p_file src on src.id = v.source_file_id and src.account_id = v.account_id left join p_generation_step s on s.id = (select max(s2.id) from p_generation_step s2 join p_generation_task t3 on t3.id = s2.task_id and t3.avatar_version_id = v.id where s2.account_id = v.account_id and s2.action_code = #{actionCode}) left join p_generation_attempt a on a.step_id = s.id and a.attempt_no = s.attempt_no left join p_avatar_action_selection sel on sel.avatar_version_id = v.id and sel.action_code = #{actionCode} where v.id = #{versionId} and v.account_id = #{accountId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into p_generation_task (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, avatar_id, avatar_version_id, source_file_id, task_kind, status, internal_state, progress, official_service_id, service_snapshot, pipeline_version, quota_reservation_id, request_id, reservation_no) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId}, #{avatarId}, #{versionId}, #{sourceFileId}, 'REGENERATE', 'QUEUED', 'READY', 0, #{officialServiceId}, cast(#{serviceSnapshot} as json), #{pipelineVersion}, #{reservationId}, #{requestId}, 1)

insert into p_avatar_action_selection (avatar_version_id, action_code, account_id, updated_at) values (#{versionId}, #{actionCode}, #{accountId}, utc_timestamp(3)) on duplicate key update avatar_version_id = avatar_version_id
mapper.update: update p_avatar_version set candidate_revision = candidate_revision + 1, assembly_revision = null, status = 'BUILDING', updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where id = #{versionId} and account_id = #{accountId} and status in ('BUILDING','REVIEW')
mapper.insert: insert into p_avatar_production_operation (account_id, avatar_version_id, action_code, operation_code, request_id, request_hash, response_json, created_at) values (#{accountId}, #{versionId}, #{actionCode}, 'SELECTION', #{requestId}, #{hash}, cast(#{response} as json), utc_timestamp(3))

insert into p_avatar_production_operation (account_id, avatar_version_id, action_code, operation_code, request_id, request_hash, response_json, created_at) values (#{accountId}, #{versionId}, #{actionCode}, 'GENERATION', #{requestId}, #{hash}, cast(#{response} as json), utc_timestamp(3))
mapper.select: select cast(coalesce(a.id, s.reserved_attempt_id) as char) attemptId, cast(t.id as char) taskId, cast(s.id as char) stepId, coalesce(a.status, 'PREPARED') attemptStatus, s.status stepStatus, cast(sel.latest_attempt_id as char) latestAttemptId, cast(sel.selected_result_id as char) selectedResultId, cast(sel.accepted_result_id as char) acceptedResultId, sel.selection_closed selectionClosed, sel.revision actionRevision, a.provider_task_id providerTaskId, a.provider_request_id providerRequestId, json_unquote(json_extract(s.result_metadata, '$.providerReceipt.imageUrl')) imageUrl, json_unquote(json_extract(s.result_metadata, '$.providerReceipt.providerTaskId')) receiptTaskId from p_generation_step s join p_generation_task t on t.id = s.task_id and t.account_id = s.account_id join p_avatar_action_selection sel on sel.avatar_version_id = t.avatar_version_id and sel.account_id = t.account_id and sel.action_code = s.action_code join p_avatar_version v on v.id = t.avatar_version_id and v.account_id = t.account_id left join p_generation_attempt a on a.id = #{attemptId} and a.step_id = s.id and a.task_id = t.id and a.account_id = t.account_id where t.account_id = #{accountId} and t.avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and s.action_code = #{actionCode} and v.status in ('BUILDING','REVIEW') and (a.id = #{attemptId} or s.reserved_attempt_id = #{attemptId}) and sel.latest_attempt_id = #{attemptId} for update
mapper.update: update p_generation_attempt a join p_generation_step s on s.id = a.step_id and s.task_id = a.task_id and s.account_id = a.account_id join p_generation_task t on t.id = a.task_id and t.account_id = a.account_id set a.status = 'SUBMITTED', a.completed_at = null, a.error_code = null, a.updated_at = utc_timestamp(3), s.status = 'POLLING', s.stage_started_at = utc_timestamp(3), s.error_code = null, s.next_run_at = utc_timestamp(3), s.lease_owner = null, s.lease_expires_at = null, s.updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where a.id = #{attemptId} and a.account_id = #{accountId} and t.avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and s.action_code = #{actionCode} and a.status in ('UNKNOWN','FAILED') and s.status in ('UNKNOWN','FAILED') and (a.provider_task_id is not null or json_extract(s.result_metadata, '$.providerReceipt.providerTaskId') is not null or json_extract(s.result_metadata, '$.providerReceipt.imageUrl') is not null)

update p_generation_task t join p_generation_step s on s.task_id = t.id and s.account_id = t.account_id join p_generation_attempt a on a.step_id = s.id and a.task_id = t.id set t.status = 'PROCESSING', t.internal_state = 'RUNNING', t.error_code = null, t.error_message = null, t.finished_at = null, t.updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where t.account_id = #{accountId} and t.avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and s.action_code = #{actionCode} and a.id = #{attemptId}

update p_generation_step s join p_generation_task t on t.id = s.task_id and t.account_id = s.account_id left join p_generation_attempt a on a.step_id = s.id and a.task_id = t.id and a.id = #{attemptId} set s.status = case when s.status = 'READY' then 'FAILED' else 'UNKNOWN' end, s.stage_started_at = utc_timestamp(3), s.error_code = 'USER_DISCARDED', s.next_run_at = null, s.lease_expires_at = null, s.updated_at = utc_timestamp(3), a.status = case when a.status = 'PREPARED' then 'FAILED' else 'UNKNOWN' end, a.error_code = 'USER_DISCARDED', a.completed_at = coalesce(a.completed_at, utc_timestamp(3)), a.updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where t.account_id = #{accountId} and t.avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and s.action_code = #{actionCode} and (a.id = #{attemptId} or (a.id is null and s.reserved_attempt_id = #{attemptId})) and s.status in ('READY','RUNNING','POLLING','UNKNOWN','FAILED')
mapper.insert: insert into p_avatar_production_operation (account_id, avatar_version_id, action_code, operation_code, request_id, request_hash, response_json, created_at) values (#{accountId}, #{versionId}, #{actionCode}, #{operationCode}, #{requestId}, #{hash}, cast(#{response} as json), utc_timestamp(3))
mapper.select: select r.action_code actionCode, cast(r.id as char) resultId, r.atlas_file_id atlasFileId, r.manifest_file_id manifestFileId, r.frame_count frameCount, r.fps, r.loop_enabled loopEnabled, cast(r.frame_layout as char) frameLayout, hex(r.content_hash) contentHash, atlas.object_key atlasObjectKey, base.id baseFileId, base.object_key baseObjectKey, hex(base.sha256) baseContentHash from p_avatar_action_selection sel join p_avatar_action_result r on r.id = sel.accepted_result_id and r.id = sel.selected_result_id and r.avatar_version_id = sel.avatar_version_id and r.action_code = sel.action_code and r.account_id = sel.account_id join p_file atlas on atlas.id = r.atlas_file_id and atlas.account_id = r.account_id and atlas.status = 'AVAILABLE' join p_file action_manifest on action_manifest.id = r.manifest_file_id and action_manifest.account_id = r.account_id and action_manifest.status = 'AVAILABLE' join p_file base on base.account_id = r.account_id and base.status = 'AVAILABLE' and base.object_key = concat(substring_index(atlas.object_key, '/', 5), '/frame-00.png') where sel.account_id = #{accountId} and sel.avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and sel.selection_closed = 1 order by field(r.action_code, 'idle','speaking','listening','thinking','nod','shake_head','wave','happy')

select (select count(*) from p_generation_step s join p_generation_task t on t.id = s.task_id where t.account_id = #{accountId} and t.avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and (s.status in ('READY','RUNNING','POLLING') or (s.status = 'UNKNOWN' and not exists ( select 1 from p_generation_step newer join p_generation_task nt on nt.id = newer.task_id where newer.account_id = s.account_id and nt.account_id = t.account_id and nt.avatar_version_id = t.avatar_version_id and newer.action_code = s.action_code and newer.id > s.id)))) + (select count(*) from p_avatar_action_selection sel where sel.account_id = #{accountId} and sel.avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and sel.latest_attempt_id is not null and sel.selection_closed = 0)
mapper.delete: delete a from p_avatar_action a join p_avatar_version v on v.id = a.avatar_version_id where a.account_id = #{accountId} and a.avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and v.status = 'BUILDING'
mapper.insert: insert into p_avatar_action (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, avatar_version_id, action_code, atlas_file_id, preview_file_id, frame_count, fps, loop_enabled, frame_layout, content_hash) select #{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), r.account_id, r.avatar_version_id, r.action_code, r.atlas_file_id, null, r.frame_count, r.fps, r.loop_enabled, r.frame_layout, r.content_hash from p_avatar_action_result r where r.id = #{resultId} and r.account_id = #{accountId} and r.avatar_version_id = #{versionId}
mapper.update: update p_avatar_version set base_file_id = #{baseFileId}, manifest_file_id = #{manifestFileId}, preview_file_id = #{previewFileId}, frame_width = 512, frame_height = 768, anchor_x = 0.500000, anchor_y = 1.000000, manifest_schema = 'LN_AVATAR_V1', capabilities = json_object('actions', json_array('idle','speaking','listening','thinking','nod','shake_head','wave','happy'), 'lipSyncMode', 'BASIC_SPEAKING'), qa_report = json_object('passed', true, 'geometryOk', true, 'allActionsAccepted', true, 'candidateRevision', #{revision}), assembly_revision = #{revision}, status = 'REVIEW', updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{versionId} and status = 'BUILDING' and candidate_revision = #{revision}
mapper.insert: insert into p_avatar_production_operation (account_id, avatar_version_id, action_code, operation_code, request_id, request_hash, response_json, created_at) values (#{accountId}, #{versionId}, '', 'ASSEMBLE', #{requestId}, #{hash}, cast(#{response} as json), utc_timestamp(3))
mapper.select: select cast(v.id as char) as versionId, cast(v.avatar_id as char) as avatarId, v.status as versionStatus, v.candidate_revision as candidateRevision, v.assembly_revision as assemblyRevision, a.visibility as visibility from p_avatar_version v join p_avatar a on a.id = v.avatar_id and a.account_id = v.account_id where v.id = #{versionId} and v.avatar_id = #{avatarId} and v.account_id = #{accountId} and a.status not in ('DELETING','DELETED','DISABLED') and v.status not in ('DELETING','DELETED')

select action_code as actionCode, revision as actionRevision, cast(selected_result_id as char) as selectedResultId, cast(accepted_result_id as char) as acceptedResultId, cast(latest_attempt_id as char) as latestAttemptId, selection_closed as selectionClosed from p_avatar_action_selection where avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and account_id = #{accountId}

select cast(r.id as char) as resultId, r.action_code as actionCode, cast(r.attempt_id as char) as attemptId from p_avatar_action_result r join p_file f on f.id = r.atlas_file_id and f.account_id = r.account_id and f.status = 'AVAILABLE' where r.avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and r.account_id = #{accountId} order by r.created_at, r.id

select s.action_code as actionCode, s.status as stage, case when s.status = 'SUCCEEDED' then null when s.status = 'READY' and (svc.id is null or sec.id is null) then 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE' else s.error_code end as errorCode, case when s.status = 'READY' and (svc.id is null or sec.id is null) then '生成服务当前不可用，尚未提交该动作请求' else null end as safeMessage, s.next_run_at as nextRetryAt, date_format(s.stage_started_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') as stageStartedAt, cast(coalesce(a.id, s.reserved_attempt_id) as char) as latestAttemptId, case when a.id is not null and (a.provider_task_id is not null or json_extract(s.result_metadata, '$.providerReceipt.providerTaskId') is not null or json_extract(s.result_metadata, '$.providerReceipt.imageUrl') is not null) then 1 else 0 end as recoverable from p_generation_step s join p_generation_task t on t.id = s.task_id and t.account_id = s.account_id left join p_official_service svc on svc.id = t.official_service_id and svc.status = 'ACTIVE' and svc.capability = 'AVATAR_GENERATION' left join p_secret sec on sec.id = svc.secret_id and sec.status = 'ACTIVE' left join p_generation_attempt a on a.step_id = s.id and a.attempt_no = s.attempt_no where t.avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and t.account_id = #{accountId} and s.step_type = 'GENERATE_ACTION' and not exists ( select 1 from p_generation_step newer join p_generation_task nt on nt.id = newer.task_id where newer.account_id = s.account_id and nt.account_id = t.account_id and nt.avatar_version_id = t.avatar_version_id and newer.action_code = s.action_code and newer.id > s.id) order by s.created_at, s.id

select cast(r.id as char) as resultId, r.action_code as actionCode, r.frame_count as frameCount, r.fps, r.loop_enabled as loopEnabled, r.frame_layout as frameLayout, r.qa_report as qaReport, f.object_key as objectKey from p_avatar_action_result r join p_file f on f.id = r.atlas_file_id and f.account_id = r.account_id and f.status = 'AVAILABLE' where r.id = #{resultId} and r.account_id = #{accountId} and r.avatar_version_id = #{versionId} and r.action_code = #{actionCode}

select cast(a.id as char) avatarId, a.visibility, a.status, a.revision, coalesce((select max(v.version_no) from p_avatar_version v where v.avatar_id = a.id), 0) maxVersionNo from p_avatar a where a.id = #{avatarId} and a.account_id = #{accountId} and a.status not in ('DELETING','DELETED','DISABLED') for update
select request_hash requestHash, response_json responseJson from p_avatar_version_operation where account_id = #{accountId} and avatar_id = #{avatarId} and request_id = #{requestId}

select cast(v.id as char) versionId, cast(v.source_file_id as char) sourceFileId, v.pipeline_version pipelineVersion, cast(v.generation_recipe as char) generationRecipe, v.status, v.manifest_file_id manifestFileId, (select count(*) from p_avatar_action a where a.avatar_version_id = v.id) actionCount, (select count(*) from p_avatar_action_selection sel join p_avatar_action_result r on r.id = sel.accepted_result_id and r.account_id = sel.account_id and r.avatar_version_id = sel.avatar_version_id and r.action_code = sel.action_code join p_file atlas on atlas.id = r.atlas_file_id and atlas.account_id = r.account_id and atlas.status = 'AVAILABLE' join p_file manifest on manifest.id = r.manifest_file_id and manifest.account_id = r.account_id and manifest.status = 'AVAILABLE' where sel.account_id = v.account_id and sel.avatar_version_id = v.id and sel.selected_result_id = sel.accepted_result_id and sel.selection_closed = 1) reusableResultCount from p_avatar_version v where v.account_id = #{accountId} and v.avatar_id = #{avatarId} and v.id = #{baseVersionId}
mapper.insert: insert into p_avatar_version (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, avatar_id, version_no, status, source_type, source_file_id, pipeline_version, generation_recipe, capabilities, qa_report, created_by, candidate_revision) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId}, #{avatarId}, #{versionNo}, 'BUILDING', 'IMAGE', #{sourceFileId}, #{pipelineVersion}, cast(#{generationRecipe} as json), json_object(), json_object(), #{accountId}, 0)

insert into p_avatar_action_result (id, created_at, account_id, avatar_version_id, action_code, step_id, attempt_id, atlas_file_id, manifest_file_id, frame_count, fps, loop_enabled, frame_layout, qa_report, content_hash) select #{id}, utc_timestamp(3), r.account_id, #{newVersionId}, r.action_code, null, null, r.atlas_file_id, r.manifest_file_id, r.frame_count, r.fps, r.loop_enabled, r.frame_layout, json_merge_patch(r.qa_report, json_object('inheritedFromVersionId', cast(#{baseVersionId} as char))), r.content_hash from p_avatar_version v join p_avatar_action_selection sel on sel.avatar_version_id = v.id and sel.account_id = v.account_id and sel.action_code = #{actionCode} and sel.selected_result_id = sel.accepted_result_id and sel.accepted_result_id is not null and sel.selection_closed = 1 join p_avatar_action_result r on r.id = sel.accepted_result_id and r.account_id = sel.account_id and r.avatar_version_id = sel.avatar_version_id and r.action_code = sel.action_code join p_avatar_action a on a.account_id = r.account_id and a.avatar_version_id = r.avatar_version_id and a.action_code = r.action_code and a.atlas_file_id = r.atlas_file_id and a.content_hash = r.content_hash join p_file atlas on atlas.id = r.atlas_file_id and atlas.account_id = r.account_id and atlas.status = 'AVAILABLE' join p_file manifest on manifest.id = r.manifest_file_id and manifest.account_id = r.account_id and manifest.status = 'AVAILABLE' where v.account_id = #{accountId} and v.id = #{baseVersionId} and v.status = 'PUBLISHED'

insert into p_avatar_action_selection (avatar_version_id, action_code, account_id, revision, selected_result_id, accepted_result_id, selection_closed, accepted_by, accepted_at, updated_at) values (#{versionId}, #{actionCode}, #{accountId}, 0, #{resultId}, #{resultId}, 1, #{accountId}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3))

insert into p_avatar_version_operation (account_id, avatar_id, request_id, request_hash, response_json, created_at) values (#{accountId}, #{avatarId}, #{requestId}, #{hash}, cast(#{response} as json), utc_timestamp(3))
